name: inset-l-shape
why: An L outline (100 x 100 less a 40 x 40 corner) inset by 10 and extruded 5. Intersection joins keep the re-entrant corner a corner, so the inset is (10,10) (90,10) (90,50) (50,50) (50,90) (10,90): 80*40 + 40*40 = 4800 mm2, 24000 mm3 exactly, eight planar faces. The corner at (50,50) lies 10*sqrt(2) from the outline's corner at (60,60); the guard on the inset reads that as the valley it is, not as 4.14 mm of slip, which is what refused every outline with a re-entrant corner before.
